mechanism: Concurrent execution of two or more branches under no ordering guarantee: a caller may not assume which branch runs, finishes, or observes state first. Genuine simultaneity and interleaving both satisfy it — the pattern is the contract, not the substrate.

data_schema.description: A parallel topology — independent branches executed concurrently with a join point.

invariants: No result may depend on the order branches were entered or completed. A branch set with an order requirement is a {{chain}}.
Each declared branch is attempted. How outcomes combine is `join_semantics` and varies.
